verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਭਏ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal chaakhat ulaTee bhiee jon kai ajon bhe kul akuleen hai ||

en.bdb: State of Guru-conscious disciples blessed by the True Guru with elixir of Naam turns opposite from the worldly involvements and are rid of the cycle of birth and death, ego and attachment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਅਉ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਭਏ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ja(n)tan te sa(n)t aau binaasee abinaasee bhe adham asaadh bhe saadh prabeen hai ||

en.bdb: Such persons who are ever relishing the Naam like elixir of the True Guru become saintly from the worldly beings. The mortal beings become immortal. They become noble and worthy persons from their ill bred and low status.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚੀ ਲਲ ੂਜਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੈ ਪੂਜ ਕੀਨੇ ਅੰਜਨ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਈ ਦੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: laalachee lal oojan te paavan kai pooj keene a(n)jan jagat mai nira(n)janiee dheen hai ||

en.bdb: The pleasure giving Naam elixir turns the greedy and covetous people into pure and worthy beings. Living in the world, makes them untouchable and unaffected by the worldly attractions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੨॥
verses.translit_en: kaaT maiaa faasee gur gireh mai udhaasee keeno anabhai abhiaasee priaa prem ras bheen hai ||182||

en.bdb: With the initiation of a Sikh by the True Guru, his bondage of maya (mammon) is sheared. He becomes indifferent from it. The practice of Naam Simran makes a person fearless, and immerses him in the love-elixir of beloved Lord. (182)
